outcome: Incidence of brachial plexus birth palsy (BPBP)
cohort: Newborns recorded in the Kids' Inpatient Database from 1997 to 2012 in the United States (5,564,628 sample births extrapolated to 23,385,597 population births)
finding: The incidence of BPBP significantly decreased over the 16-year study period, coinciding with a significant increase in the rate of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a lower incidence of BPBP.
